scripts.packages:build: corepack pnpm --filter @dark-factory/client build && corepack pnpm --filter @dark-factory/ui build
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm run packages:build && corepack pnpm --filter dark-factory-dev typecheck
scripts.build: corepack pnpm run packages:build && corepack pnpm --filter dark-factory-dev build
scripts.test: corepack pnpm run packages:build && node --test packages/client/test/*.test.mjs packages/ui/test/*.test.mjs packages/ui/src/factory-scene/*.test.mjs
scripts.check: corepack pnpm run packages:build && corepack pnpm --filter dark-factory-dev typecheck && node --test packages/client/test/*.test.mjs packages/ui/test/*.test.mjs packages/ui/src/factory-scene/*.test.mjs
